messages.author: ecfda580123e3920
messages.subject: renderDataTable options not functioning
parts:
Hi guys, 

I built a shiny App. Some data frames were shown as Data Tables. 

  output$mytable6 = renderDataTable({
    fetchConneByChoice(input$query, input$inText)
  }, options = list(lengthMenu = c(1, 2, 4), searching = FALSE,
                    pageLength = 1, autoWidth = FALSE))


On my local computer, everything works just fine. I published this App on my Linux server (http://ricencode.ncpgr.cn/). And then the data tables were not shown properly as it was ordered by the code above. This part is not working:

options = list(lengthMenu = c(1, 2, 4), searching = FALSE,
                    pageLength = 1, autoWidth = FALSE))

I guess these options may override by system default. But I can't figure out how to make these options work.

Thanks in advance!

library(shiny);sessionInfo() from your server with the output of your
local computer?
